title: Careers
intro: We are a family owned crew producing trail and ultra races since 2009, from our Phoenix headquarters to start lines across the West.

hero.alt: Aravaipa course crew member in a safety vest directing runners at Javelina Jundred, Four Peaks behind

openings.heading: Current openings
openings.empty_text: We are not hiring for any role at the moment. When a job opens it shows up here and on our job board the same day.
openings.stay_text: If you want us to know you are out there, send us a note through the contact form (topic: Something else) with what you do and where you are.
openings.ways_text: You can also work a race with us as a volunteer, or race for us on the Racing Team.

stats.label: Trail and ultra events a year

life.heading: What we do
paragraphs: We build the race, start to finish. Our team spans race directors, aid station leads, event crew, technology, design, printing, warehouse and logistics.

items.title: Race production
items.text: Courses, aid stations, start and finish lines for more than 50 trail and ultra events a year.

items.title: Broadcasts
items.text: Mountain Outpost carries our races live, with multi-camera livestreams from the start line to the backcountry.

items.title: Timing
items.text: We chip time our own events, including remote timing points that work off grid, with live results.

items.title: Artworx and Printworx
items.text: Custom wooden medals, buckles and awards, plus race apparel and merchandise, made by our own team.

life.alt: Aid station crew serving fruit and snacks to a runner at Zion Ultras

life.heading: Phoenix, and wherever the race is
paragraphs: Our headquarters is in Phoenix, Arizona, and we have an office in Colorado Springs.
Race weekends take the crew to Arizona, California, Colorado, Nevada and Utah, and to races in Michigan, New Hampshire, Tennessee and Wisconsin.
life.alt: An Aravaipa Running staff member carries a brush cutter along the Highline Trail as storm clouds build over the Mogollon Rim

life.heading: Hard work, family feel
paragraphs: We are incredibly hard working and passionate about what we do, and we keep a fun, laid back vibe in the office and the same family feel at our events.
We look for high energy, self motivated people who are not afraid to get their hands dirty, and we see ourselves as trail stewards and community builders.

ways.heading: Not a job, still the crew

items.title: Volunteer
items.text: Work an aid station, a course sweep or the finish line at one of our races. Volunteers earn race credits toward a future race.
